page_title: LYO 2-3 PSG | Lyon v PSG 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) serves up a nice cross, but Gianluigi Donnarumma punches the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon.
90+6' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
90+2' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.

90+2' 2 - 3 It's a goal! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) makes it 2:3. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Ainsley Maitland-Niles and planted his close-range header into the right side of the goal. Gianluigi Donnarumma was helpless.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' Surely that's handball by one of the PSG players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.
89' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Gianluigi Donnarumma with a brilliant diving save!
85' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Kang-In Lee tees up Achraf Hakimi (PSG) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Lucas Perri.
85' The referee gives a yellow card to Thiago Almada (Lyon) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.

83' 1 - 2 Goal! Georges Mikautadze plays in Rayan Cherki (Lyon), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 1:2.
82' Nuno Mendes (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

81' Thiago Almada (Lyon) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
81' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Ainsley Maitland-Niles replaces Sael Kumbedi (Lyon).
80' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) will be replaced by Georges Mikautadze.
80' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) commits a foul during an attacking move.
79' PSG are ruled offside.
74' The game has come to an end for Bradley Barcola. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kang-In Lee (PSG).
74' The referee signals a substitution. Goncalo Ramos is brought on as a substitute for Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
74' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' Malick Fofana (Lyon) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
70' That was close by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
69' Nuno Mendes (PSG) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
68' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Hernandez (PSG) replacing Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.

66' What a sweet touch by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
64' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Nemanja Matic (Lyon) is replaced by Alexandre Lacazette.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) will be replaced by Thiago Almada.

63' This was a piece of cake for Lucas Perri. Joao Neves (PSG) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
61' Here comes a substitution. Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Desire Doue.

60' 0 - 2 Ousmane Dembele (PSG) scores with a great individual effort! He makes a good run, skips past defenders and fires the ball from the edge of the box past the diving goalkeeper. The shot went inside the left post. Absolutely phenomenal!
59' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
58' Vitinha (PSG) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.

57' Malick Fofana (Lyon) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Gianluigi Donnarumma was alert and the score remains the same.
55' Malick Fofana (Lyon) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

53' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Bradley Barcola, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Achraf Hakimi (PSG), who beats Lucas Perri with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
52' PENALTY APPEAL after Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
51' Bradley Barcola (PSG) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
49' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) commits a foul and Eric Wattellier immediately signals a free kick.
46' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Eric Wattellier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
41' Joao Neves (PSG) is penalised for a foul. Eric Wattellier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
40' Nuno Mendes (PSG) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
39' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
36' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

35' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Lucas Perri pulls off an easy save.
35' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
32' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
30' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
30' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

29' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag and Lyon will take a corner.
26' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post.
25' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
24' Bradley Barcola (PSG) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

23' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Bradley Barcola (PSG), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Desire Doue (PSG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
19' A pass by Desire Doue (PSG) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
15' PSG fail to score from a corner as Lucas Perri (Lyon) leaps to collect the ball.
13' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
13' What a great touch by Ousmane Dembele (PSG) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
11' Vitinha (PSG) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Bradley Barcola.
9' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Desire Doue (PSG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lucas Perri, who smothers the ball.
5' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' The foul by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) was seen by Eric Wattellier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lyon will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Eric Wattellier.
